title: eslint 12 残余 — restrict-template-expressions + strict-boolean + no-namespace + 剩 unnecessary-condition
description:
剩余 12 violations (60 - 4 real bug - 3 auto-fix - 27 return-type - 14 require-await):
- 6× `no-unnecessary-condition` (dag-executor 2 处外, 其他 6 处)
- 3× `restrict-template-expressions` (template literal 里 concat 非 string/number)
- 1× `strict-boolean-expressions` (if/while 判断非 bool)
- 1× `no-namespace` (legacy `namespace X { ... }` 应改 module)
- 1× 未 categorize 的

**Performer 独立诊断每处**:
- `no-unnecessary-condition`: dead code 删, 或 type narrow 后 refactor
- `restrict-template-expressions`: `${x}` where x 是 object → `${String(x)}` 或加 toString
- `strict-boolean-expressions`: `if (x)` where x 可能是 undefined → `if (x !== undefined)`
- `no-namespace`: 改成 `export * as X from './x'` 或普通 module

**追责链**: EPIC-150 canary style rule (剩余).

per_rule_diff_rationale.no-namespace (auth.ts): Express Request augmentation requires `declare global { namespace Express }`; `eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-namespace` with documented justification (only documented way to augment @types/express Request from a module).
per_rule_diff_rationale.restrict-template-expressions x3 (rate-l: Wrapped `${number}` expressions in `${String(number)}` to satisfy 'must be string/number' rule.
per_rule_diff_rationale.no-unnecessary-condition (heartbeat.ts x: Removed dead `body.status !== undefined && typeof body.status === 'string'` (status type is `string`, not optional). Removed `body.currentTaskId !== undefined` (type is `string | null`; null is valid).
per_rule_diff_rationale.no-unnecessary-condition (tasks-claim.ts: Removed dead `body.performerId === undefined` (performerId type is `string`, not optional).
per_rule_diff_rationale.no-unnecessary-condition (tasks.ts x2): Removed dead `body.ticketId === undefined` and `body.progress === undefined` (both types are non-optional in CreateTaskRequest / UpdateProgressRequest).
`phase3Arbitration.aggregated` is hardcoded `true`, so `&&` always true; simplified to `phase1.architectMerged`.
per_rule_diff_rationale.no-unnecessary-condition (master-electio: After `cached?.status === 'ready'` early return, `cached.status !== 'ready'` is always-true; simplified to `if (cached !== undefined)` (preserves same behavior: quit-and-replace any non-ready cached connection).
`opts?.['force']` is `boolean | undefined`; changed to explicit `=== true` to express the intent (only push --force when explicitly true).
per_rule_diff_rationale.strict-boolean-expressions (dimensions.t: `!arg?.startsWith('--')` returns `boolean | undefined`; split into two separate ifs (`if (arg === undefined) continue; if (!arg.startsWith('--')) continue;`) to avoid nullish-in-conditional.
per_rule_diff_rationale.prefer-optional-chain (master-election.t: Manual fix: `cached !== undefined && cached.status === 'ready'` → `cached?.status === 'ready'` (undefined short-circuits to false; semantically equivalent).

ci_grep_test.jsdoc_excluded: ' * no @ts-ignore or : any in this JSDoc' → excluded OK

These were introduced by an external linter modification (void (async)() → ())() that left `await` calls orphaned. NOT introduced by EPIC-150-E. Out of ticket scope (the 5 in-scope lint rules all 0).
verification.vitest: 964 total tests, 958 passed, 2 failed, 4 skipped. 2 failures are dead-code-sentinel-coverage-d tests triggered by the same pre-existing 'await in non-async IIFE' issue (workflow.ts and tasks.ts). NOT a regression from EPIC-150-E. EPIC-150-E did not modify test files.
